usage: 印度尼西亞 is used as a proper noun to refer to the country Indonesia.
You can use 印度尼西亞 to talk about the country in both formal and written contexts.
When mentioning 印度尼西亞, you usually treat it as singular and use singular verbs.
It can appear in sentences talking about geography, travel, culture, or nationality.
印尼 is the more common short form in daily speech, but 印度尼西亞 is more formal.

examples.meaning: I will travel to Indonesia next year.
